mapper.insert: insert into activity_admission_outbox(id, payload, attempts, next_attempt_at) values(#{id}, #{payload}, 0, now())
mapper.select: select id, payload, attempts, next_attempt_at, date_add(now(), interval 120 second) as claim_until from activity_admission_outbox where sent_at is null and dead_at is null and next_attempt_at <= now() order by next_attempt_at, id limit 100
select count(*) as pending, coalesce(timestampdiff(second, min(created_at), now()), 0) as oldestSeconds from activity_admission_outbox where sent_at is null and dead_at is null
mapper.update: update activity_admission_outbox set next_attempt_at = #{claimUntil} where id = #{id} and sent_at is null and dead_at is null and next_attempt_at = #{dueAt} and next_attempt_at <= now() and #{claimUntil} >= date_add(now(), interval 90 second)
update activity_admission_outbox set sent_at = now(), last_error = null where id = #{id} and sent_at is null and dead_at is null and next_attempt_at = #{claimUntil}

update activity_admission_outbox set last_error = #{error}, dead_at = case when attempts + 1 >= 5 then now() else dead_at end, next_attempt_at = date_add(now(), interval least(300, greatest(5, (attempts + 1) * 2)) second), attempts = attempts + 1 where id = #{id} and sent_at is null and dead_at is null and next_attempt_at = #{claimUntil}
mapper.select: select id, payload, attempts, next_attempt_at, dead_at, last_error from activity_admission_outbox where sent_at is null and dead_at is not null order by dead_at desc limit 200
mapper.update: update activity_admission_outbox set dead_at = null, attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = now() where id = #{id} and sent_at is null and dead_at is not null
update activity_admission_outbox set sent_at = now() where id = #{id} and sent_at is null and dead_at is not null
